products.title: Ash Catcher W/Barrel Diffuser
products.descriptionHtml: The Glass house Ash Catcher attaches to your glass water pipe to keep resin and ash from ending up in your bong water. It traps the ash and other byproducts of burning flower. With these byproducts trapped, it won't make it into the bong water and into your lungs. Essentially it acts as an extra filter to provide you with a cleaner and smoother bong rip!
